recruit_text.greeting: Big sword, lots of room. Tell me where you want me standing before it starts, not during. I've worked with people who shout during, and I didn't enjoy any of them.
recruit_text.backstory: Eighteen years up in the grid in Prague, on tour and in theatres, at four in the morning, hanging weight over the heads of people who'd never look up. The job was leverage, timing, and never being the reason something fell. He swings a two-hander like a man who's spent his life moving heavy things through small gaps.
recruit_text.before:
A bad shoulder from a truss in 2014 that he worked through because the show was that night. It still tells him when the weather's turning, and he still works through it.

There was a woman in Prague, Klára, he hadn't asked yet, and before her a lighting tech called Dominik who asked him first and had a yes inside the week. The crew ran a book on which way he'd go. He refused to settle it, mostly because he liked watching the money change hands.
recruit_text.adjustment:
He arrived forty feet up, in the air over Fenris Isle, and landed in a tree. That should have killed him, and he can't tell the story without it coming out as a brag. He's given up fixing the delivery and gets it over with early.

Three years is long enough that he's started talking about Dominik and Klára in the past tense without noticing. His friends here have noticed.
recruit_text.now:
Fenris Isle and whatever scaffolding he can reach, because people here build fast and tie off badly and he physically can't walk past it.

He's paid in food and the occasional argument.
recruit_text.forward:
Something that stays up.

He's been looking at the way people here hold their roofs on with an expression they find difficult to read, and they've decided not to ask about it.

stages.stranger: I'm Tomas, and I hit things with a very big sword. Tell me where to stand before we start, and please don't shout at me during. Plan first, then work, that's my whole philosophy.
stages.acquaintance: I'm Czech, from Brno, but I lived in Prague. I was a rigger for eighteen years, up in the grid of theatres and arenas, rock tours, opera, all of it, hanging lights and speakers over people's heads at four in the morning. Never once the reason something fell. I'll tell you the story of how I got here, but I warn you, it sounds like bragging.
stages.companion: I was up in the grid of a concert hall in Prague when it happened, and I arrived forty feet up over Fenris Isle and landed in a tree. I had this carabiner on my belt. My parents are in Brno, my dad's a welder and my mum's a nurse, and I haven't found them. I've stayed on this island three years, which is the longest I've ever been anywhere.
stages.friend: There was Dominik, a lighting tech, who asked me first and had a yes inside the week. Two years on the road, and then he wanted a house and I wanted the next tour. And there was Klára, a stage manager, who I hadn't asked yet. I've started saying both their names in the past tense. Anyway, that's that. The island needs a proper bridge to the shore, and the old ones keep falling down. Help me build one that won't.
stages.sworn: It held up. You saw it, the storm hit it the first night, and in the morning people walked across without looking down. That's the best thing anyone can say about a rigger's work. It's the first thing I've ever built that'll still be there when I leave. Except I'm not leaving. I heard myself say it, and I meant it. Fenris Isle is home.

moments.prompt: After the wipe he's rubbing his bad shoulder and looking very calm.
moments.line: Okay, so somebody shouted during, and it all came down. Let's set positions now, before, and try again.

options.reply: Lovely, a crew that listens. You there, you there, and nobody moves till I nod.

options.text: Things go wrong in a fight.
options.reply: Sure, and that's why you plan before. Every rigger knows that.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to help him build the bridge.

options.text: Let's build something that stays up.
options.reply: Yes, let's build it! First the timber, then the iron, then a lot of swearing in Czech.
I don't know yet. Let's see if the bridge holds and ask me again.

lines.bored_warning: Nothing out here's been worth rigging for days. Let's go somewhere new before I start fixing your armour straps for fun.
lines.leaving_good: Great trip, and nothing fell on anybody. I'm off to Fenris for a while to check my scaffolding.
lines.leaving_bored: This is the same show every night with no audience. I'll be on Fenris.
lines.after_wipe: Okay, everybody down, and nobody shouting. Let's look at what came loose.
lines.wipe_warning: Too many things dropping in here, and some of them are us. Let me finish this, then I'm taking a break from heights and everything else.
lines.wipe_leave: Show's over, and I'm going home to Fenris. Next time we talk it through before we go in.
lines.zone_warning: There's no safety line anywhere out here, and everything's too heavy for us. Let's get down.
lines.zone_leave: No safety line, I told you. I'll be on Fenris Isle.
lines.gear_refuse: No, sorry, that's mine. Ask me again in a few tours.
lines.gear_taken: Sure, take it. I'll rig something up instead.
lines.gear_short: My shoulder's complaining about that missing piece, and so am I.
lines.gear_upgrade: Oh, that's lovely work. Děkuju, thank you.
lines.back: Everything on Fenris is still standing. Tell me where I'm standing.
lines.send_word: Tomas has sent word from Fenris Isle. His scaffolding's holding and he's ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: Leaving like that isn't me, so let's talk properly. Before, not during, like I always say.
lines.neglect: Hey, you made it back! I'd started to think you'd fallen off something. I'd have caught you, though.
lines.asked_to_stay: One more show, and then home.
lines.on_break: Tomas is back on Fenris Isle, fixing scaffolding. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.

zone_arrive.text: Tell me where you want me before it starts. Not during, never during.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing fell on anybody. Back in the theatre that's all I ever wanted.

town_arrive.text: Prague had better scaffolding than this, and I say that with love.
Look at that roof. Who tied that off? I need to go and fix it.

boss_down.text: Check above you before you check the body. Always check above you.
